lines.text: import { DEFAULT_PACK_ID, THEME_PACKS, THEME_SURFACE_NAMES, type ThemePack } from "./theme-packs";
/** id of the managed <style> holding the active pack's variable overrides. */
// Tolerate environments without Storage (SSR / mini-DOM component tests).
// Accept a builtin id, or any id resolveThemePack can satisfy (installed).
* Apply a theme pack by rewriting a managed <style> that overrides the base
* `--cs-*` variables for both modes. The rules mirror the base sheet's
* :root / .dark selectors and are appended after it, so equal-specificity
* overrides win while the `.dark` class keeps deciding the active mode. The
* default pack restores the base palette and clears all optional decoration.
// Same-origin windows (the pet popout) share this localStorage; a `storage`
/** i18n key (builtin) or plain display name (installed). */
/** Representative color (unitless HSL) for the picker swatch — the pack's primary. */
/** Optional per-state pet sprites; missing states fall back to the default dog. */
/** Optional background image; absent means the plain color background. */
/** Per-area decoration; the legacy wallpaper is the window fallback. */
/** Decorative outer frame for the main app window only. */
/** Optional short UI cues, played only after the user enables theme sounds. */
/** Local audio assets or explicit external listening links. Never auto-played. */
/** builtin ships with the app; installed comes from ~/.code-shell/themes/. */
* Built-in packs. `default` overrides nothing (falls through to the base sheet,
* i.e. the current brand orange). Accent packs recolor the primary + focus ring
* (and its foreground for contrast) in both modes; everything else inherits the
* neutral base so density/contrast tuning is preserved. Character themes also
* provide their full palette, bundled surface artwork and window frame.
